title: Egg and sweetcorn skillet
summary: Egg and sweetcorn skillet is a mexican dinner built around medium eggs and canned sweetcorn, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Pat medium eggs dry and season it. Prep canned sweetcorn and red peppers for Egg and sweetcorn skillet so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook medium eggs on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook canned sweetcorn and red peppers in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Egg and sweetcorn skillet before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice medium eggs and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
